briefs.claim_en: Two crocodiles were seen in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysore yesterday evening.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple news reports confirm that crocodiles have been sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysore on various occasions. The Hindu reported a sighting in March 2010. Star of Mysore reported sightings in September 2023, December 2024, and January 2026. Andolana also reported a sighting in March 2024. These reports indicate that the lake is a known habitat for crocodiles, and sightings are not uncommon.
gaps_en: No evidence specifically confirms two crocodiles were seen in Kukkarahalli Lake on October 8, 2026.
No official statements or recent reports corroborate the specific event claimed.
